EXPERT DISTRIBUTION IN REFRIGERATED TRANSPORT
ChillXpress has been involved in chilled and frozen food distribution all over the UK and Europe for a number of years. Based in the Midlands & close to all major Motorway networks, our Management team has over 65 years’ experience between them, working within this industry.
If you’re looking for flexibility and reliability or switching your supplier of temperature-controlled deliveries, look no further than ChillXpress. From frozen to chilled products, we can ensure that any refrigerated goods we transport will reach their destination in the same condition as they left yours.
You will be in good hands!
All our temperature-controlled vehicles carry modern monitoring systems, which allows our team to monitor loads at all times of their journey and provide our clients with up to date data.
We deliver a wide range of food products including fruit & vegetables, dairy, meats, fish and pharmaceuticals products. Our fleet of trailers offer temperature-controlled transport, delivering ambient, chilled, and frozen food and are all equipped with monitoring systems.
ChillXpress Ltd – Built For Ambition
We are flexible to accommodate seasonality loads, promotions, and other change in demands, ensuring we are responsive to your business needs 24hrs a day.
Speciality Services Include:
Frozen, chilled or ambient
Dual temperature control vehicles
Mixed temperature loads
Express delivery of samples
Experienced team of drivers
Clients Benefit From:
Either single or dual temperature trailers
24/7 mechanical and refrigeration support
Vehicle tracking in real time
Experienced skilled office team
On time deliveries + fast deliveries
Over 30 years’ experience in the industry
Fully Covid-19 compliant
Providing you with a service tailored to all your needs.
Our client base includes, Fowler Welch, ABP Ltd, Joyce European Logistics and DFDS to name a few.
Goals & Objectives
The businesses main goals and objectives is to provide excellent transport services to our existing clients and to expand our customer base within the food industry throughout the UK and Europe.
